name: clause-analyser
description: Rates the dispute resolution (arbitration) clause of an agreement on Presolv360's 5-point scale.
long_description: Attach an agreement and ask Claude to rate the clause. The rating comes from fixed rules, so the same clause always gets the same rating. You get a visual card, a dashboard for several agreements, recommendations and PDF downloads. This tool gives a first review, not legal advice.

tools.name: rate_clause
tools.description: Rate a dispute resolution clause out of 5

tools.name: show_report_card
tools.description: Show the visual report card for one agreement

tools.name: show_portfolio
tools.description: Show the dashboard for several agreements

tools.name: suggest_better_clause
tools.description: Suggest wording that raises the rating

tools.description: Save a PDF report for one agreement
